setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Two 8-step channels at 90 BPM. Channel 1 has Pattern 1 (C D E F on steps 1 to 4) as its Foundation anchor and Pattern 2 (trigs on steps 5 and 7) as additions. Channel 2 (MIDI channel 2) has one anchor trig on step 5 and is channel 1's Interlock leader. Interlock removes channel 1's addition on step 5, so channel 1's grid shows steps 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7 lit. Clock Rate is /1 and Swing is not set (X).
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Turn E1 to Channel tasks, turn E2 to Clock and press K3. Set Feel source to CHANNEL (E3, then K3) so this channel uses its own feel instead of the Song page's. Then select Swing and turn E3 up to 25. Swing runs from -50 to 50 and at 25 every second step is played a quarter of a step late.
steps.title: Set Swing to 25

steps.caption: Open Merge Shape > Interlock: Status is still ON and step 5 is still removed (step 7 is lit). Swing did not change the merge.
steps.title: Interlock is still on

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8), listen to a loop or two and tap Play again to stop. Step 5 is still silent. Steps 2 and 4 sound a quarter of a step (about 42 ms) late: in the MIDI strip they sit near 208 ms and 542 ms instead of 167 ms and 500 ms, while steps 1 and 3 stay put (0 and 333 ms) and the added step 7 plays quietly (velocity 70) at 1000 ms. Swing moves the notes but the merge result stays the same.
steps.title: Hear the swung notes

title: Swing a merged part: Interlock still removes step 5
